name_input: EUGIA PHARMA SPECIALITIES LIMITED; EUGIA PHARMA SPECIALITIES LIMITED; EUGIA PHARMA SPECIALITIES LIMITED; EUGIA PHARMA SPECIALITIES LIMITED; EUGIA PHARMA SPECIALITIES LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/eugia-pharma-specialities-limited): 'Total Shipments 7988 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28'. Exact row quoted: '2026-02-28 | EUGIA PHARMA SPECIALITIES LIMITED | EUGIA US LLC, | NICARDIPINE HYDROCHLORIDE INJECTION 25MG/10ML (2.5MG/ML) (10 S PACK)(QTY : 4392PACKS)- HYDERABAD ACC INHYD4, India | NEW YORK, UNITED STATES | 30049079 | 1113446'. Second row same date: '2026-02-28 | EUGIA PHARMA SPECIALITIES LIMITED | APL SWIFT SERVICES (MALTA) LTD | ERTAPENEM FOR INJECTION 1G/VIAL ... | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | MALTA | 30042099 | 1137728'. Third: '2026-02-28 | ... | DANANG PHAMACEUTICAL - MEDICAL | AMPICILLIN AND SULBACTAM FOR INJECTION 3G ... | HYDERABAD ACC INHYD4, India | HO CHI MINH C, Vietnam | 30041060 | 1136868'. Source counter: page states 7988 total shipments / 156 trading partners / 115 ports; rows actually visible on the free page: 4 shipment rows (all dated 2026-02-28), plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows. Only 4 of 7988 records were inspectable.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record could be retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India-sales split were not accessible: web_search backend returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' for the query '"Eugia Pharma Specialities" GeM tender contract domestic supply GST turnover', and thecompanycheck.com, volza.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. No domestic figure is asserted; null.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs export records with destination (USA, Malta, Vietnam), HS codes and B/L numbers are visible on ImportKey, latest 2026-02-28, with 7988 total records. Note the declared HS 300450 does not match the observed export codes (30049079, 30042099, 30041060, 30042064) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). The claimed industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' is also inaccurate — the shipment lines are injectable pharmaceuticals (Aurobindo group sterile/oncology arm), not petrochemicals. Domestic (intra-India) supply evidence: not found in accessible sources — stated as unknown, not as 'conditionally accepted'. PAN AADCE3429K and state Rajasthan were not verified by any accessible source and are not confirmed here.
